name: Flaflow
description:
While building websearch from scratch at Neeva, we also added AI features for search. However, what we realized was that, no matter how good your AI search feature was, often, the user just wanted the AI to follow their instructions instead of doing its own research. This made me realize -- instead of fighting hallucinations and the AI making dumb mistakes (which is a losing battle), it's better to teach the AI, step by step, what you want it to do, like how you'd teach an intern. Then, the AI can follow your instructions, reliably and at scale.
Our company is going to change the future by making large SaaS companies obsolete. In the past, you had one large company, like Salesforce, identify a problem and spend many millions of dollars and thousands of engineers to make a solution. However, if I were to make my own CRM, it wouldn't look like Salesforce, so Salesforce really is an 80% good solution to all of its users.
